subTitleDesc.sub_title: 大學教育如何接軌職場實務
subTitleDesc.sub_describe: 讓學子了解學校教育所學之知識，如何轉換為職場所需之智能，並受到職場肯定與認同。

description.describe_ch: 主要目的為銜接實習專業課程，使學生於進行專業實習前能充分瞭解實習企業的基本規範及相關職場禮儀，以利學生未來參與實習。
description.describe_eh: In order to connect with the internship program, this course is a preparatory course, which is designed to help students understand the job specification, business courtesy and working attitude for a enterprise before they join in the internship program. The students can be earlier familiar with the occupational ethics, regulations, and learning methods.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
上課時請尊重多元文化與個人特質，切勿嘲諷其他同學的問題、想法與意見
請注意兩性平權問題，不要有不當的言語霸凌或肢體碰觸
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
上課請盡量準時，並且維護其他同學的受教權益
課程提供輔導協助，不論有任何問題 : 學習、工作、待人接物處事，都歡迎提出喔 !
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Please pay attention to the following three things; 
1. Please try to be punctual in class, and do not be late or leave early.
2. You can ask questions if you have questions in class, but do not chat privately, which will cause noise disturbance to other students and hinder the teaching rights and interests of other students.
3. The course provides counseling assistance, no matter if you have any questions: study, work, dealing with people, you are welcome to ask!
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
履歷自傳請以誠實為原則，不要虛構造假
自我介紹可以強化個人優勢與專長，但請勿無中生有
經歷建議適度美化，但切忌虛偽造假
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Here are three things to keep in mind;
1. The resume autobiography should show one's strengths and emphasize one's abilities and expertise. But please be honest and don't be hypocritical or lying.
2. Self-introduction needs to explain personal strengths and expertise, and the attitude when speaking needs to be appropriate and appropriate, and there should be no hypocrisy, fraud, boasting, etc.
3. It is recommended to beautify the experience moderately, but avoid falsification, and it is recommended to put forward specific facts or documents.
